summary: Watched Disaster Desk's two Shorts with retention plus the two newest; added one lesson about the second beat and one challenger about the ending.
why: The tanker Short lost 15.5% at 5.3 s when beat 2 cut to an unrecognisable orange rudder cutaway over 'stuck to starboard'; Lac-Megantic lost 11.3% at 5.4 s with its speed dial reading 3 while the voice said 65.

findings.title: Second beat is the biggest drop
findings.detail: v-20261122-41 -15.5% at 5.3 s (rudder cutaway, 'starboard'); v-20261121-42 -11.3% at 5.4 s (dial behind the spoken 65).

findings.title: Weak endings
findings.detail: Both end on a comment-question board; end hold 31% and 25%, held after the hook 27% and 21%.

findings.title: Tacoma repeats the risk
findings.detail: v-20261124-41's beat 2 is backstory over a calendar card; no retention yet, check Friday.

changes.title: Lesson added: the second beat stays on the whole thing, in plain words
Challenger added: end on the fact, not a question board
